applies_to: structural mesh and structural time-step cases only
disposition_of_revision_2: Retain stage10_structural_mesh_coarse_a02 as a rejected measurand design because the endpoint support produced stress but top-edge curvature and residual displacement at the numerical-noise scale.
revised_material_fixture: Both layers use the Chapuis Prusament instantaneous modulus, Poisson ratio and normalized 23-branch amplitudes at a 65 degC reference. The upper half uses the source relaxation times multiplied by 10; the lower half uses the source times unchanged.
revised_boundary: The end traction is removed over 31-32 s and the free edge remains traction-free through 62 s.
purpose: Create an identifiable, smooth two-layer mismatch benchmark with simultaneous post-unload curvature, residual displacement and self-equilibrated stress for numerical refinement only.
interpretation: The factor of 10 is a declared synthetic fixture, not a measured layer property, temperature shift, uncertainty bound or production PLA parameter.
